meta.note: Subset of races/classes for Godot character creation. Tier-1 classes only. Origins/alignments/perks are Godot-only starter content.

races.name: Pure Human
races.description: Standard human with balanced potential across all areas.

races.name: Neo-Human
races.description: Human with cybernetic enhancements. Enhanced physical capabilities.

passive.name: Targeting Array
passive.description: Accuracy is always 100%. Critical Hit Chance +5%.

races.name: Ancient Bloodline
races.description: Descendant of an ancient powerful lineage. Natural affinity for cultivation.

races.name: Spirit Beast
races.description: A creature with spiritual energy flowing through its veins.

races.name: Demon Kin
races.description: Mixed heritage with demonic ancestry. Dark power courses through you.

races.name: Celestial Descendant
races.description: Bloodline touched by celestial beings. Radiant energy within.

races.name: Shadow Walker
races.description: Born from the void between realms. Natural stealth and darkness affinity.

races.name: Dragon Blood
races.description: Ancient dragon heritage. Immense physical and magical potential.

races.name: Undead Awakened
races.description: Risen from death with unnatural vitality and dark power.

passive.name: Undying Will
passive.description: Survive with 1 HP once per battle.

races.name: Phoenix Reborn
races.description: Reborn from fire with blazing power and eternal resilience.

races.name: Fae Touched
races.description: Kissed by fae magic, dancing between worlds with trickster grace.

races.name: Mechanical Construct
races.description: Artificial being of gears and circuits. Pure logic, no soul.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Beginner-friendly frontline fighter focused on direct melee combat.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Beginner-friendly agile class built around stealth and burst windows.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: Beginner-friendly caster class using straightforward elemental spells.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Beginner-friendly support class with healing and protective holy magic.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: Beginner-friendly martial class focused on combos and chi control.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Beginner-friendly ranged class with tracking and companion support.

loadouts.name: Marksman
loadouts.description: Ranged starter kit: Piercing Shot + Keen Eye.

loadouts.name: Arcanist
loadouts.description: Caster starter kit: Arcane Bolt + Mana Trickle.

loadouts.name: Acolyte
loadouts.description: Support starter kit: Holy Mend + Toughness.

loadouts.name: Shadow
loadouts.description: Mobility starter kit: Shadow Step + Fleet-Footed.

activeSkills.name: Slash
activeSkills.description: A reliable melee strike. Low cooldown, good for learning timing.

activeSkills.name: Piercing Shot
activeSkills.description: A ranged shot that ignores a portion of armor. Good vs tough enemies.

activeSkills.name: Arcane Bolt
activeSkills.description: A simple spell projectile. Scales with Intelligence.

activeSkills.name: Holy Mend
activeSkills.description: A small heal that stabilizes early fights.

activeSkills.name: Shadow Step
activeSkills.description: A short reposition that breaks line-of-sight briefly.

passiveSkills.name: Lucky Breaks
passiveSkills.description: Small chance to avoid a negative status effect.

origins.name: Street Urchin
origins.description: You grew up surviving on instincts, favors, and fast feet.

trait.name: Quick Hands
trait.description: +1 Dexterity (creation only). Better odds on early lockpicks.

origins.name: Apprentice Scholar
origins.description: You studied scraps of forbidden knowledge and learned to read the world.

trait.name: Book-Learned
trait.description: +1 Intelligence (creation only). Unlocks extra lore prompts.

origins.name: Temple Acolyte
origins.description: You learned discipline, ritual, and the weight of vows.

trait.name: Rite of Shelter
trait.description: Start with a small protective blessing (placeholder).

origins.name: Frontier Hunter
origins.description: You track, observe, and strike when the moment is right.

origins.name: Arena Recruit
origins.description: You learned to fight for crowds and coin, under harsh rules.

trait.name: Crowd-Ready
trait.description: +1 Strength (creation only). Start with a basic combat consumable.

origins.name: Exiled Noble
origins.description: You have manners, debts, and enemies with long memories.

trait.name: Commanding Presence
trait.description: +1 Charisma (creation only). Better early negotiation prompts.

options.name: Ritualist
options.description: Story rituals have an extra outcome option (placeholder).

archetypes.name: Balanced
archetypes.description: A safe start that adapts to whatever you find.

archetypes.name: Glass Cannon
archetypes.description: High damage, low safety. Best with careful positioning.

archetypes.name: Bulwark
archetypes.description: High survivability. Wins long fights and protects allies.

archetypes.name: Trickster
archetypes.description: Evasion, crits, and opportunism. Strong with stealth and timing.

options.name: Offense
options.description: Plan toward burst damage and crit synergies.

options.name: Defense
options.description: Plan toward mitigation, sustain, and resistances.

options.name: Utility
options.description: Plan toward mobility, control, and exploration perks.

alignments.name: Lawful Good
alignments.description: Order and compassion. You keep your word.

alignments.name: Neutral Good
alignments.description: Kindness first. Rules are tools, not chains.

alignments.name: Chaotic Good
alignments.description: Freedom and mercy. You break cages.

alignments.name: Lawful Neutral
alignments.description: Structure above all. The system must stand.

alignments.name: True Neutral
alignments.description: Balance and pragmatism. Survive, adapt, endure.

alignments.name: Chaotic Neutral
alignments.description: Impulse and independence. You choose your own path.
